explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/373: Hickerson conjectured that the only non-trivial solutions are 9! = 2!3!3!7!, 10! = 6!7!, 10! = 3!5!7! and 16! = 14!5!2!. The statement records the weaker consequence that 16! = 14!5!2! is a solution (16!/14! = 240 = 5!·2!) and that every solution has n ≤ 16, matching the docstring's 'largest solution' framing. Faithful.
